title: Factor Theorem Form
text:
The Factor Theorem says $(x - a)$ is a factor if $f(a) = 0$.

We have $(x + 2)$, which can be written as $(x - (-2))$.

title: Identify the Value
text:
Comparing $(x + 2)$ with $(x - a)$:

$x + 2 = x - (-2)$

So $a = -2$, meaning we substitute $x = -2$.

title: The Value to Substitute
text: We substitute $x = -2$ into $f(x)$ and set the result equal to zero.
